basis: The printing heads this gloss 'VERS. 7.' and it opens 'Vers. 7. Quasi ad alienos durius loquebatur. Non est deputandum crudelitati quod sic'. The printing's caput and the lemma's own words, matched against the Clementine, name the same chapter.
date_basis: Remigius taught at Reims and then at Paris and died about 908. His scriptural commentaries are products of that teaching and are not separately dated; the range covers the years in which he taught. The date is the writing, not Migne's 1853 printing.
text: Vers. 7. Quasi ad alienos durius loquebatur. Non est deputandum crudelitati quod sic fratres afflixit, vel quod mutuam cognitionem diu distulit, quia hoc fecit volens experiri utrum a malitia cessassent qua eum vendiderant, et an tales existerent erga fratrem suum qualem erga se eos fuisse noverat, quem in exteris regionibus vendiderant.
